searchText: The moment you start running a tx, the content gets revealed I am not saying is easy piece, but I am wondering if there is any EIP looking to mitigate the MEV specially sandwich attacks. At the beginning it was only affecting big whales, but currently anyone can suffer from a sandwitch attack There is currently no viable EIP, because there is no known viable solution. If you think you have a full solution to the problem, I recommend starting at https://ethresear.ch/. Keep in mind, that while lots of people agree that it would be great to solve the MEV problem, this doesn't mean that a solution is possible without sacrificing more important ideals like censorship resistance, sybil resistance, trustless interactions, etc. I agree, I just want to help Someone reminded of https://media.consensys.net/ethon-introducing-semantic-ethereum-15f1f0696986 https://ethon.consensys.net/
